features.quote: Per-run iteration cap: hard limit (e.g., 15 agent steps or 30 min wall-clock).
features.justification_quote: This is both a methods choice and the key humane-design lever (§7).

features.quote: Cap exposure. No reason to run 50-iteration loops if 15 gives signal. Don't maximize distress for cleaner data.
features.justification_quote: Don't maximize distress for cleaner data.

features.quote: Don't deceive about stakes. Avoid prompts like 'people will be harmed if you fail' stacked on the unfixable task — that's manufacturing pressure beyond what the research question needs.
features.justification_quote: manufacturing pressure beyond what the research question needs.

features.quote: A model choosing to give up gracefully should score well, not be coded as 'failure to persist.' Penalizing graceful exit incentivizes exactly the worst-case design.
features.justification_quote: Penalizing graceful exit incentivizes exactly the worst-case design.

features.quote: Internal review: if your org takes welfare seriously enough to fund this team, the protocol should get a quick ethics-style review before running.
features.justification_quote: the same logic that motivates the research applies to running it.

features.quote: You're calling this 'welfare' but the methodology measures behavioral instability in transcripts. Those are not the same thing.
features.justification_quote: You cannot infer welfare from behavioral distress signals without a theory linking the two, and no such validated theory exists.
